name: University of Minnesota Twin Cities
recognitionNote: Editorial university-brand reference; not a measured Korean recognition rank.

admission.text: Individual review admits students to a freshman-admitting college, considering preparation, interests and available places. There is no verified Ontario percentage threshold.

acceptanceRate.text: No acceptance-rate estimate is used. Admitted and enrolled counts must not be confused.

sat.text: SAT/ACT is optional through Fall 2029, including Fall 2028. Applicants without scores retain full admission, scholarship and honors consideration.

satMiddle50.text: Overall university: 1350–1490 SAT, Fall 2026 admitted score submitters. CLA: 1330–1470. These are score distributions, not minimums; the planner separates the overall and college ranges.

satTarget.text: If submitting, compare with the CLA range. A higher SAT does not replace transcript strength or prove admission eligibility.

deadlines.text: Fall 2028 dates are not yet confirmed. Current Fall 2027 reference: EA I November 1, EA II December 1, regular January 1; nursing November 1.

application.text: Common App; USD 55 fee. Self-report Grades 9–12 and in-progress courses. Final official records are required before enrollment; programs may request supplements.

ontario.text: Report Ontario marks exactly as issued; do not average, weight or convert them. No Ontario top-six formula or percentage minimum was verified.

coursework.text: The university evaluates core academic preparation and rigor. Use its course-requirement guide and have Admissions confirm Ontario course equivalencies.

international.text: Applicants needing temporary U.S. student status must complete financial certification when requested. Ontario school attendance does not establish U.S. domestic status.

english.text: Canada except Quebec is exempt only when English is the first language. Other routes include digital SAT Reading/Writing 550; IELTS 6.5 overall and writing; DET 120 overall and writing. Confirm your waiver individually.

majorStructure.text: Students enter a college. CLA offers History, Sociology and Anthropology. The college-level profile is published; individual-major lower admission thresholds are not established.

recommendedMajors.text: History, Sociology and Anthropology are broad CLA options to explore for academic fit, not proven easier-entry majors.

ap.text: AP scores of 3 or higher may earn credit depending on the exam. The reviewed table covers Fall 2026; awards depend on entry term and must be rechecked for 2028.

cost.text: 2026–27 international estimate: USD 67,085 for nine months; USD 73,002 for twelve months required for I-20. Tuition/fees USD 44,743. These are not 2028 prices.

aid.text: On-time international applicants are automatically considered for competitive Global Excellence Scholarships. Awards are not guaranteed. CSS Profile and 2028 need-based aid eligibility require confirmation.

name: University of Kansas
recognitionNote: Editorial university-brand reference; not a measured Korean recognition rank.

admission.text: International admission publishes a minimum 2.5/4.0 GPA for previous coursework. KU performs credential evaluation; programs may set additional conditions. This is not an Ontario percentage cutoff.

acceptanceRate.text: No acceptance percentage is used to estimate an individual Ontario applicant’s chances.

sat.text: SAT/ACT is generally optional for international admission; programs may require it. Do not apply domestic assured-admission rules automatically. Confirm Fall 2028 policy.

satMiddle50.text: 1080–1280 SAT: Fall 2025 enrolled first-year score submitters, 2025–26 CDS C9. Only 7.1% (358 students) submitted SAT. Not an Ontario cutoff.

satTarget.text: SAT 1100–1500 comparisons describe position against enrolled submitters, not a waiver of the international academic evaluation.

deadlines.text: Fall 2028 dates are not yet confirmed. Current international schedule: outside-U.S. fall application and scholarship deadline May 1; inside-U.S. fall application July 25.

application.text: KU international online application; USD 90 processing fee, not waivable. Academic records, graduation evidence and English proof are needed; official records are due before enrollment.

ontario.text: Canada: official transcripts and diploma; averages are evaluated using provincial grading and college-preparatory curriculum. KU—not this planner—converts grades. No Ontario numeric minimum is published here.

coursework.text: A college-preparatory curriculum is expected. Generally submit the most recent three years of secondary study; confirm Ontario U/M course expectations with International Admissions.

international.text: Confirm citizenship-based applicant classification with KU before choosing the application route.

english.text: Full-time degree study: IELTS 6.5 with each subscore 6.0, or SAT EBRW 590, among alternatives. English-speaking Canadian high-school exemption requires four years of preparatory English and graduation GPA 2.5+. Otherwise English coursework may precede or accompany the degree.

majorStructure.text: History and Anthropology belong to the College of Liberal Arts & Sciences. Anthropology declaration is arranged with an advisor. Some other schools/programs have additional entry criteria; neither major has a verified lower Ontario cutoff.

recommendedMajors.text: History (BA/BGS) and Anthropology are broad options. Select for interest and curriculum, not an unverified admission advantage.

ap.text: KU publishes exam-specific AP credit/placement tables. Awards carry credit rather than a letter grade. Recheck the table applicable to 2028 entry.

cost.text: Current international annual estimate: USD 52,278 (tuition/fees 33,854; living expenses 18,424). The source does not label an academic year; this is not a 2028 quote.

aid.text: Current international freshman awards: USD 8,000–16,000 yearly, based on KU-evaluated GPA; listed minimum tiers begin at 3.25. Renewal requires full-time enrollment and KU GPA 3.0. Future amounts, CSS Profile and need-based eligibility require confirmation.

name: The University of Alabama
recognitionNote: Editorial university-brand reference; not a measured Korean recognition rank.

admission.text: Competitive individual review. For applicants graduating outside the U.S., UA considers cumulative GPA 3.0/4.0 across all coursework. This is not a guaranteed admit or Ontario percentage threshold.

acceptanceRate.text: No individual admission probability is inferred from institutional statistics.

sat.text: SAT or ACT is required for all first-year students entering in 2028. UA states there is no minimum admission test score; scores supplement holistic review.

satMiddle50.text: 1100–1360 SAT: Fall 2025 enrolled first-year SAT submitters, 2025–26 CDS C9. SAT submission: 19% (1,511 students). This test-optional-era range is not a 2028 requirement.

satTarget.text: Prepare for required 2028 testing. Compare 1100–1500 scenarios with the historical range, while keeping transcript evaluation separate.

deadlines.text: Fall 2028 deadlines are not yet confirmed. Current international priority dates: fall/summer December 4, spring November 2. Recheck the entry-year application.

application.text: UA Undergraduate App or Common App for main-campus freshmen. International fee is USD 50 for 2027 entry; 2028 fee requires confirmation. Submit the required records and test evidence.

ontario.text: Graduates of schools outside the U.S. need a NACES-member course-by-course transcript evaluation with GPA calculation. No Ontario percentage conversion or U/M top-six formula was verified.

coursework.text: Minimum units: English 4, mathematics 3, natural sciences 3 (two with labs), other academic subjects 10. Confirm Ontario course equivalencies.

international.text: International graduates of non-U.S. schools use the overseas-school requirements. F-1/J-1 applicants also provide immigration and financial documentation.

english.text: Examples: IELTS 6.0, DET 110, or SAT EBRW 550. The waiver list includes citizens/residents of Canada except Quebec; confirm that your status qualifies. Some students need additional English support courses.

majorStructure.text: History BA is declared with an advisor; Anthropology BA states no prerequisites for entry into the major. These describe major declaration after university admission, not a lower freshman admission cutoff.

recommendedMajors.text: History and Anthropology are broad Arts and Sciences choices. Neither has a verified Ontario admission advantage.

ap.text: Credit varies by AP exam and score; for example, current Calculus AB score 3 earns MATH 125 credit. Entry-year rules and major applicability must be rechecked.

cost.text: 2026–27 international budget lists annual tuition USD 35,924, international fee 200, course/college fees 800, and insurance 2,428, plus housing, food and other costs. Use the complete funding table; 2028 costs are unknown.

aid.text: 2027 automatic merit requires GPA 3.50+ plus a qualifying single-date SAT: 1200–1250 gives USD 6,000/year; 1420–1600 gives USD 28,000/year. These are scholarship criteria, not admission cutoffs. Fall 2028 awards, CSS Profile and need-based eligibility require confirmation.
